notes.title: Teleportation Book Item further fixed
notes.content:
[h1]Hello.. again :D[/h1]

[h3]The item "Teleportation Book" is not glitchy anymore.

Hope you enjoy the game now, with all old and new updates![/h3]

notes.title: End game scene little fix
notes.content:
[h1]Hello![/h1]

[h3]Only a minor thing about not be able to leave before last boss. Now you can restock if needed :)[/h3]

notes.title: Minor fixes and some new art and wallpapers!
notes.content:
[h1]Helloooooo pretty you![/h1]

[h3]I have updated the Credits Image in game and also fixed some more minor typos and wall/tile clipping issues.

I also have found added some WALLPAPERS in the Steam game folder if you'd like to decorate your desktop with some groovy art!

ENJOY![/h3][img]https://img.itch.zone/aW1nLzQ3NjA5MjUucG5n/original/GxNk%2Fk.png[/img]

notes.title: A new useful item can be found in game.
notes.content:
[h1]Hello real gamers![/h1]

[h3]This time a new item can be found.
A Teleportation Book! Makes the travelling back to town less time consuming.

But where can it be found? :P[/h3]

notes.title: Upgrade your World Map!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hey again![/b][/h1]
[h3]A little bigger update now with new content to the game.
This time a new NPC is added which sells directions and tips for you to see on your World Map-item.

Find him. He is not hard to find!

His directions are well worth it.
8 directions to the dungeons and 2 major bonus Secrets!.

A whole new location added![/h3]

notes.title: Minor Fixes with Onion description and minor stuff
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Fellow Lotharusians or whatever we call us in Lotharus!?[/h2]

[h3]A little help to understand how to get rid of poison have been added where you first met Saborilli.
And some other minor issues have been taken care of.

Enjoy![/h3]
